name: Wide-mouthed jar with pointed base
dimensions: H. 19.5 x Diam. (across body) 17 cm (7 11/16 x 6 11/16 in.)
summary: Deep pear-shaped vessel with lightly flared thickened lip, rounded bottom, and flattened conical projection at base; red earthenware lightly burnished on the exterior and decorated with a chevron-pattern painted in black slip before firing; interior with encrustations of earth from burial. Early middle Yangshao culture, Shijia type. From the middle Yellow River valley region, Shaanxi province.
